# aimee (generated packaging)

Generated from the `aimee-shop/` source in
https://github.com/aimee-shop/plugin. See the repository README
for per-client install instructions. Plugin id is `aimee`.

## Tenant / store scope

This packaging pins the hosted MCP server (https://mcp.aimee.shop/mcp)
with no header defaults. To scope `use_sdk` calls, use the `set_scope`
tool (or the `set-scope` skill) mid-session, or pass `tenant` /
`store` on each call.

If your client's MCP settings support custom headers, you can
additionally set `X-Aimee-Tenant` (UUID or slug) and `X-Aimee-Store`
(UUID) as project defaults; a store header wins over a `set_scope`
pin, so leave it unset if you want mid-session store switching.
